show.description: Arundhati, once heir to a grand mansion, is silenced by betrayal and forced to live as a servant while her uncle and cousin steal her life. Her only ally, Adi, hides his true identity - her childhood fiancé and a billionaire, living in disguise to protect her. Together they shatter the web of lies, awaken her lost voice, and reunite her with her father, who rises from a sixteen-year coma to see his daughter reclaim her destiny. Watch now!
